adherence.reason: The scene centers on an extended spoken exchange between Elara and Kaelen.
Elara serves as the apparent human representative and Kaelen is explicitly an alien ambassador composed of obsidian, basalt, granite, and magma-veined rock.
Their formal welcome and Elara's statement that the team has waited years establish this as their first encounter.
Kaelen does not speak exclusively in questions; he makes declarations including 'You are not her,' 'She did not come,' and 'Your eyes are too perfect.'
The entire exchange occurs in an orbital conference chamber where both figures float in explicit zero gravity.
The exact word 'translator' appears multiple times.
The text explicitly reveals synthetic skin and metallic chassis, identifies Elara as a hollow robot placeholder, and says the real Elara is hiding and weeping rather than attending.
The final line is Kaelen asking Elara, 'Are you afraid?'
